_provenance: HAND-BUILT negative controls, 2026-09-11. These are the result sets the TESTER constructed to show the detector condemning good searches (attempt 1: the CrashLoopBackOff set; attempt 2: these two). They cannot be captured live, because the live plane returns only bing and bing does not answer these queries either - which is the point: a detector must not depend on the live plane being healthy to be shown wrong. Titles and snippets are ordinary pages of the kind a working engine returns; the subject ENTITY is present in every one.
